# agent-utils

A [Claude Code plugin marketplace](https://docs.claude.com/en/docs/claude-code/plugins) — skills, slash commands, subagents, hooks, and helper scripts.

Each utility lives under `plugins/<name>/` and is installed independently. Pick only what you need.

## Plugins

<!-- BEGIN: plugins-catalog (auto-generated by scripts/update-readme-catalog.sh — do not edit by hand) -->
| Plugin | Category | Description |
|--------|----------|-------------|
| `disk-cleanup` | workflows | Identify macOS disk space hogs and interactively clean them up. |
| `excalidraw-diagram` | workflows | Generate Excalidraw diagrams that argue visually — concept-driven layouts, evidence artifacts, and a render-and-validate loop that catches layout defects before delivery. |
| `git-bare-convert` | workflows | Convert an existing plain `git clone` into a `.bare/` + worktrees layout in place, without re-cloning. Re-attaches the current branch as the first worktree. |
| `git-commit` | workflows | Write Conventional Commit messages with a tight, why-focused body. Skips the verbose 50-line transcripts of the diff that LLMs default to. |
| `git-worktree` | workflows | Bootstrap and operate a bare-clone + worktree layout, so multiple branches live as sibling folders off a single repo and agents stay scoped to their own working tree. |
<!-- END: plugins-catalog -->

## Quick start

In Claude Code, add the marketplace once:

```
/plugin marketplace add TheNomet/agent-utils
```

Then **browse and install interactively**:

```
/plugin
```

This opens a picker showing every plugin in every marketplace you've added, with descriptions. Pick what you want — no need to know names up front.

If you already know the plugin name, you can install directly:

```
/plugin install <plugin-name>@agent-utils
```

Other useful commands:

- `/plugin marketplace info agent-utils` — list everything in this marketplace
- `/plugin marketplace list` — list marketplaces you've added
- `/plugin marketplace update agent-utils` — pull the latest registry

> **Tip — point an agent here and let it install for you.**
> Open Claude Code in any repo and say:
> *"Add the marketplace `TheNomet/agent-utils` and install the plugins I need for &lt;task&gt;."*
> Claude will run the right `/plugin` commands.

## Repo layout

```
.
├── .claude-plugin/
│   └── marketplace.json     # registry of all plugins in this repo
├── plugins/                 # one folder per plugin
│   └── <plugin-name>/
│       ├── .claude-plugin/plugin.json
│       ├── skills/          # SKILL.md files (auto-loaded workflows)
│       ├── commands/        # /slash-commands
│       ├── agents/          # specialized subagents
│       ├── hooks/           # PreToolUse / PostToolUse hooks
│       └── scripts/         # helper scripts referenced via ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}
├── templates/plugin/        # copy this when adding a new plugin
├── scripts/
│   └── update-readme-catalog.sh  # rewrites the Plugins block above from marketplace.json
├── .pre-commit-config.yaml  # hooks: catalog sync, conventional commits, hygiene
├── CONTRIBUTING.md
└── README.md
```

## Plugin types

A plugin can ship any combination of:

| Component  | Path                      | What it does                                                                 |
|------------|---------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Skill      | `skills/<name>/SKILL.md`  | Loaded by Claude on-demand based on its description. Encodes workflows/rules. |
| Command    | `commands/<name>.md`      | A `/slash-command` users can run.                                            |
| Subagent   | `agents/<name>.md`        | Specialized agent Claude can delegate to.                                    |
| Hook       | `hooks/hooks.json`        | Pre/Post tool-call automation.                                               |
| MCP server | `.mcp.json`               | Adds an MCP server while the plugin is enabled.                              |
| Scripts    | `scripts/`                | Bash/Python helpers, callable from skills/commands.                          |

## Adding a new plugin

See **[CONTRIBUTING.md](./CONTRIBUTING.md)**. Short version:

1. Install hooks once after cloning: `pre-commit install -t pre-commit -t pre-push -t commit-msg`.
2. `cp -r templates/plugin plugins/<your-plugin>`
3. Edit `plugins/<your-plugin>/.claude-plugin/plugin.json`.
4. Fill in skills/commands/agents/scripts you need; delete the rest.
5. Register the plugin in `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json`.
6. Open a PR — the pre-commit hook will refresh the README plugin catalog for you.
